capabilities: Pair Markdown notes with PDFs automatically or via a vault-wide picker
Generate paginated Markdown drafts from a PDF's text layer
Synchronize text selections bidirectionally with fault-tolerant highlighting
Insert PDF page tags into unpaginated Markdown automatically
Edit page blocks inline and write changes back to the note
disambiguation: Not a PDF merger, annotator or viewer; it aligns a Markdown note with a PDF for textual collation and proofreading.
extras: Distributed as a beta plugin via BRAT and still at v0.1.3; the README warns users to back up notes before batch pagination or editing important texts. A standalone browser web demo (Collatio, on GitHub Pages) mirrors the plugin's behavior without installing Obsidian. All processing is local, with no external services, accounts or payment.
problem: Obsidian offers no side-by-side workspace for checking a Markdown note against its source PDF, so aligning quotes, page numbers and OCR errors must be done manually.
